messages:
Sean: Quick sync @Marta @Ian @Nina — Acme's POC -> contract conversion has special billing asks: split invoice 60/40 with two PO numbers, net30, two DocuSign signers, and explicit KMS language in the DPA. Should we do one order form referencing both POs or produce two order forms? Also request pricing hold for 90 days after PO issuance.

Marta: We usually prefer one order form per legal entity, but finance can handle split invoices if each line references a cost center. Need billing contact, EIN, and PO numbers to route.

Sean: Details below (pasting):
PO-A: ACME-880-01 -> $48,000 (60%)
PO-B: ACME-880-02 -> $32,000 (40%)
Legal signer: alice@acme.com
Finance signer: bob.finance@acme.com
Entity: Acme Inc (EIN: 12-3456789)
Billing address: 123 Industrial Ave, Suite 400, Palo Alto, CA 94000
Cost centers: CC-TR-60, CC-TR-40
Invoice terms: Net30

Nina: We can commit to a 90-day pricing hold if they convert to an annual committed plan; will draft clause. Confirming SLA: they asked for Gold Dedicated.

Ian: From legal side: single order form referencing both PO numbers is preferable (avoids duplicate contract records). DPA must include KMS addendum and BYOK option if they want key ownership. Also need subprocessor limitations for any on-prem telemetry. If customer insists on two order forms, we'll insert cross-reference language which adds review time.

Marta: Finance says split invoice is fine if PO numbers and cost centers appear on relevant invoice lines; invoices should be sent to bob.finance@acme.com and include EIN. AP needs approver name on invoice.

Sean: Uploaded redlines: https://files.internal/acme/redlines-v1.pdf. Note conversion credit: 10% of first-year committed spend if converted within 90 days of PO issuance. Nina, pls add to order form.

Nina: Draft clause to add: "Pricing hold: Quoted rates will be held for 90 days from PO issuance for conversion to a committed annual agreement. If executed within that window, customer is eligible for a one-time credit equal to 10% of first-year committed spend." Adding SLA Gold and Dedicated capacity toggle.

Ian: Created DPA KMS addendum draft; flagged BYOK, key ownership language, and subprocessor carve-outs. If they accept Redwood-managed KMS initially we can shorten review.

docu-sign-bot: docu-sign-bot created envelope `env_0x9f4b2d` sent to alice@acme.com, bob.finance@acme.com 5 status: sent.

Marta: I'll prep the invoice template and request the approver name for AP. Also ask finance if they need a tax exemption certificate.

Sean: Customer counsel (jessica.counsel@acme.com) asked about tax exemption handling. Flagged to finance.

Ian: Action items: 1) Legal to confirm DPA + KMS addendum language; 2) Nina to add pricing-hold & SLA text; 3) Marta to route invoice once DocuSign completes; 4) Sean to publish final order form referencing both POs when legal clears.

docu-sign-bot: envelope `env_0x9f4b2d` status update: signed by alice@acme.com (2024-11-07T09:02:12Z). Waiting on bob.finance@acme.com.

Marta: Once Bob signs I'll push to AP and issue invoice.

Sean: Thanks all, leaving thread open for final signer and any last finance docs.

Marta: Bob signed this morning, AP routed. Invoicing scheduled. Closing loop once invoice paid.

Ian: Legal acked KMS addendum with BYOK option; counsel may request minor edits to subprocessor carve-outs — I'll handle.

Nina: Order form updated with pricing hold + SLA Gold. I'll hand over the final draft to Sean for publication.

Sean: Publish when ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
